timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹102.01 Cr, net profit ₹38.08 Cr.
Antelopus Selan Energy reported FY26 revenue of ₹278.9 Cr and net profit of ₹89.6 Cr, driven by higher sales volumes averaging 1,355 boepd.
Payal Upadhyay, Promoter of Antelopus Selan Energy Limited, declares no encumbrance on shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
H1FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹250.12 Cr, net profit ₹111.61 Cr.
Antelopus Selan issued its Q2FY27 investor presentation highlighting drilling progress in Bakrol and Karjisan and a ₹6.5 Cr cess refund.
Audio recording of Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings call held on October 26, 2026 made available on company website.
